method: Nonnegative sum conservation on explicit same-definition team totals. Missing team totals do not certify anything. Residual >0 is not allocated to a player. Explicit zero total tackles implies zero won and zero signed net. Existing conflicts are never overwritten.
controls: 12 initial pilot fixtures across six seasons; 12 later-date fixtures preselected before data collection for temporal confirmation. No universal zero-omission rule.
acceptance: Apply conservation only to individual team/field groups with valid integers and exact sum equality. Reject missing totals and all residuals/conflicts. Field mapping must agree on pilot and temporal checks; shared Opta ancestry is not independent-provider validation.
